verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a first-party MCP server at its developer docs. The server lets AI assistants and autonomous agents query spend, manage cards, pay vendors and handle reimbursements, and a probe confirms the official MCP page exists. missing for 10: documented connection/setup details (transport, endpoint URL, auth flow for MCP clients), independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Jeeves MCP server lets AI assistants and autonomous agents manage your company's finances — ask about card spend, pay a vendor, pull a statement, or submit a reimbursement, all without opening the Jeeves app.
Manage cards — list and filter company cards, issue new virtual cards, update names, spending limits, and reset intervals.
official MCP server documented at https://tryjeeves.redocly.app/mcp
